metadata.title: Concentrix shares slide after earnings, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
Concentrix shares slide after earnings, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Tuesday's premarket action:
Concentrix shares are sliding nearly 24% after the the AI-powered customer experience platform missed second-quarter earnings expectations and issued poorly-received guidance.
Enphase Energy shares are jumping 9% after a report that the U.S. is drafting a ban on imports of foreign inverters, which connect solar projects and batteries to the grid.
Shares of Strategy, the bitcoin hoarder, are down 3.5% on heavy volume as the the price of the biggest crypto currency once again falls below $60,000. Strategy jumped 12.6% Monday after the company said it would sell bitcoin to buy back its stock.
